verdict.rationale: Digits ships an official, hosted, OAuth-gated MCP server at api.digits.com/mcp, with documented setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Perplexity. The vendor says it lets AI assistants 'query live, auto-booked financial data', and a probe confirmed the endpoint is live and auth-gated. The Connect API also exposes on-demand balance sheet, cash flow, P&L and AP/AR aging statements, which supply exactly the live-ledger grounding an affordability question needs. Ask Digits separately claims to answer cash-flow, budget and forecast questions. Missing for 10: no hands-on or independent evidence of an agent actually answering an affordability question accurately, and no evidence that runway/forecast data is exposed through the API or MCP rather than only in the app.
